preconditions.description: The number of knitting needles K is between 1 and 50000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 999 and 1 <= y <= 999 and 1 <= z <= 999 for x, y, z, _, _, _ in needles)
preconditions.description: Each coordinate x, y, z of the triples in the needles is between 1 and 999 inclusive.
Each needle is represented by a set of two distinct triples.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'True closed chains' if any(cycle for cycle in true_cycles) else return_value[0] == 'No true closed chains'
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is 'True closed chains' if there is at least one true closed chain in the sculpture, otherwise it is 'No true closed chains'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[1] == 'Floor closed chains' if any(cycle for cycle in floor_cycles) else return_value[1] == 'No floor closed chains'
postconditions.description: The second line of the output is 'Floor closed chains' if there is at least one floor closed chain in the sculpture, otherwise it is 'No floor closed chains'.
